map.按受害部位选防治法: Choose a control method by affected part
map.按植物与症状定位：白粉病（叶背白霜）、霜霉病（黄斑背霉层）、蚜虫（嫩梢聚集）、红: Locate by plant and symptom: powdery mildew (white coating on leaf undersides), downy mildew (yellow spots with mould on the underside), aphids (clustering on tender shoots), spider mites (fine webbing plus yellow specks on leaf undersides), scale insects (hard shells on stems); control splits into physical (water jet / sticky traps), biological (ladybirds / matrine) and chemical (registered pesticides).
map.月季嫩梢见密集小绿虫+蜜露→蚜虫：先喷水冲淋或黄板诱杀，严重时喷吡虫啉/苦参碱；: When rose tender shoots show dense small green insects plus honeydew → aphids: first spray water to wash them off or use yellow sticky traps, and in severe cases spray imidacloprid or matrine. At the same time, if a white powder appears on leaf undersides → powdery mildew: remove diseased leaves, increase ventilation and spray thiophanate-methyl or similar. When both occur together, treat the pest first then the disease and avoid stacking pesticide damage.
map.能不能只用物理防治？: Can I rely on physical control alone?
map.轻度发生可水冲、人工摘除、黄/蓝板诱杀；密度高或蔓延快仍需登记药剂，注意安全间隔: For light infestations water jets, hand picking and yellow/blue sticky traps work; at high density or fast spread you still need registered pesticides, observing the safety interval.
map.合理密植通风、避免叶面积水、轮作、强健植株（适量肥水）可显著降低发病。: Reasonable spacing and ventilation, avoiding standing water on leaves, crop rotation and strong plants (adequate fertiliser and water) significantly reduce disease.
